split.note: Each share becomes a part payment on this order.
move.hint: Pick what moves. The new order keeps the same server and table. Payments already taken stay on this order.
move.button_one: Move {count} item to a new order
move.button_other: Move {count} items to a new order
move.keepOne: Leave at least one item on this order.
move.paidTooMuch: {paid} is already paid on this order, so at least that much has to stay.
sync.review.priceMismatch: {product} was sold at {recorded} while offline, but an admin had changed the price to {server}. The sale is kept as recorded.
sync.review.archivedProduct: {product} was sold after it was taken off the menu. The sale is kept as recorded.
sync.review.revokedDevice: This phone was removed from Kaunta, so this was kept aside for an admin.
sync.review.other: The server kept this but could not apply it.
pair.title: Connect this phone
pair.body: Ask an admin for a 6-digit pairing code from Staff & devices, then type it here.
pair.invalid: That code didn’t work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
pair.tooMany: Too many wrong codes. Wait 10 minutes and try again.
pair.offline: Connect to the internet to pair this phone.
pair.loading: Connected. Getting the menu and staff list…
pair.failed: Couldn’t reach the server. Check the internet and try again.
landing.promise: Kaunta shows you when your till, your cash, and your shelf don’t agree.
landing.counterHint: For staff on the counter phone
landing.adminHint: See today’s money, approve, and run your bars
landing.notPayments: Customers pay the bar directly by M-Pesa or cash. Kaunta records what was served and paid; it never takes payments.
bar.title: Which bar is this counter for?
bar.body: Type the bar code from your owner or manager. You only do this once on this phone. After that, staff tap their name and enter their PIN.
bar.label: Bar code
bar.invalid: That code doesn’t match a bar. Check it with your owner or manager.
bar.liveHint: A 6-digit pairing code from your manager works here too.
bar.demoHint: Demo: Baraka Pub’s code is {code}. Every bar’s code is in admin → Staff & devices.
bar.change: Use this phone for another bar
landing.installHint: Opens like an app, works offline.
landing.installIos: To install on iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
landing.installed: Kaunta is installed on this device.
login.noStaff: No one can log in here yet. In admin → Staff & devices, the owner or a manager adds people and sets their PINs.
login.removed: {name}’s access was removed, so they were signed out. Everything they recorded is saved.
login.noPin: {name} has no PIN yet. Ask the owner or a manager to set one (admin → Staff & devices).
